messages:
lee: Quick design pass on the metrics tile in staging. At 240px width the legend collapses into one cramped line and axis unit text clips. Screenshot: https://staging.redwood.app/snap/5123

anya: Re: legend — propose a compact collapse pattern: show up to 2 items inline, then a "+N" control that expands a keyboard-focusable flyout with the full list. Keeps tile height small.

frank: For axis labels, suggestion: adaptive formatting. Below 1k show full ms precision (e.g., 430 ms). Above 1k switch to short SI (1.2k) and add a concise hover card with exact value.

sam: Outlier handling thought: cap the y-axis at p95 to avoid axis explosion, render outliers as faded markers in an "overflow lane" above the chart with a pill that reads e.g., "4 outliers". Clicking opens modal with raw timestamps.

lee: Accessibility: the "+N" control must be accessible — aria-haspopup and aria-expanded, and when expanded the flyout should trap focus. Also ensure screen readers get the full series order.

aria-bot: accessibility-note: screen reader users report that long legend names are noisy. Recommend sr-only full names mirrored in DOM order and visible truncation for sighted users.

anya: Smoothing: don't change default smoothing. Instead add a toggle in the flyout: "Show smoothed overlay" with explanation: "Smoothed for trend only; raw data remains for alerts." Add a small "S" microbadge to legend items that are smoothed.

frank: For overlapping outliers, ttl jitter the x-position slightly and add a subtle drop shadow to make counts discoverable without changing scale. Tooltip should list all overlapping values with keyboard navigation.

sam: Copy nit for pill: use concise text "4 outliers > 2.4s" and aria-label "4 outliers above 2.4 seconds, open details" so it's brief visually but verbose for SRs.

lee: Also add `aria-live=\"polite\"` to overflow pill so SRs are notified when count changes, but rate-limit announcements to avoid spamming during bursts.

product-kate: Heads up — we'll feature this in the release notes as "improved small-tile legends and outlier handling". Don't flip existing dashboards until pilot is complete.

anya: Plan: i'll prototype compact + flyout patterns and share in this thread. frank will mock overflow lane and modal, sam will run NVDA/VoiceOver passes on the expanded flyout states. lee to write microcopy for badges/tooltips.

frank: Also proposing a chart prop `legendBehavior: \"inline+flyout\" | \"stack\" | \"auto\"` so product can opt-in per page.

lee: Great. Merging behind flag. We'll iterate after a small pilot and the a11y pass. :thumbsup:
